text: Implemented ebeb1da. Registered shared mvpa-fit with minimal fit+mvpa+multivar dependencies. CanonicalGeometrySchedule enforces Fixed/PerRun or exact TrainingFold temporal scopes; CanonicalMoments accumulates ZtZ and ZtX in primitive loops and derives E/R without trial betas or TxT projectors; CanonicalEffectMvpa traverses ROI/searchlight FeatureSetPlans, aggregates only training runs, freezes multivar CanonicalEffectFit, evaluates held-out roots, and returns aligned ordinary MvpaResult metrics plus typed fold payloads/receipts. Independent tests cover streamed-vs-batch moments, dense projector equivalence, ROI/searchlight execution, held-out leakage, stop control, schedule validation, and absence of TrialReadout/beta artifacts. Full mvpa-fit: 13/13 JVM and 13/13 JS.
